text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(It's quiet. So very quiet—and yet, 
everyone's raw excitement ripples through 
the air...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Here, where nothing stands in the way... 
All I feel is anticipation, heat, and—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I'm—gonna winnnnn!! 
HAAAAAAAAAH!!"

The moment they tore across the finish 
line, 
light broke through the 
clouds—illuminating the victor.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's Daring Tact! 
Daring Tact has done it!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She has surpassed the great legend before 
her! 
She has carved open a brand new eraaaa!

Daring Tact won. 
Toppling the strongest horsegirl of our 
time— 
she had magnificently claimed the mantle 
of the next champion.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Tact...! 
I knew you were..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Gh. 
You're strong! So, so strong...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I've made up my mind, I will beat you 
next time! Definitely! 
So someday—let's race again!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Even so.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye... The history you carved into 
the turf will never fade away. 
No one can ever rewrite what you 
achieved...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye... Thank you for giving us so 
many dreams...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(I defeated Almond Eye. 
That will undeniably go down in history as 
a fact.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(And yet... that does not mean I have 
drawn level with the dazzling brilliance 
she radiated.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Then where I must go from here is...

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ...What an incredible race.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"...It's still far away. For now. 
But—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Tore-san. 
—I won!"

Daring Tact was standing at the very 
summit of the new era. 
First, I showered her with praise for her 
sheer greatness.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Even now, I still can't believe 
I actually won against Almond Eye..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Almond Eye is a horsegirl who will 
forever live on in history. 
A runner who has carved such vivid, 
indelible hoofprints..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I don't think I've reached the heights of 
her brilliance yet. 
There is still a vast distance separating 
her and me."
choice_data_list:
That's probably... the difference in 
experience.

That's probably... the difference in 
experience.

text_block_list.text:
After claiming the Triple Tiara, Almond 
Eye ventured into the classic 
middle-distance route and overseas, 
blazing a trail that was entirely her own.
choice_data_list:
That's why she became the horsegirl she is 
today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: "...Then, Tore-san—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Do you think that as I gain experience, I 
can become a horsegirl that everyone 
recognizes as 'unrivaled', too?"

It was, without a doubt, the sprouting of 
ambition. 
Through this race, Daring Tact had 
awakened to the pride of a true 
"champion."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Tore-san... Do you think I can become a 
more steadfast light?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: "...Thank you so much."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I want to grow stronger. 
I want to win on even grander stages."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Not just as a horsegirl from Hidaka, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"—as the Triple Tiara horsegirl everyone 
cheered for... 
I want to show everyone even bigger 
dreams...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Tore-san, please help me think about it. 
About the path where I can shine even 
brighter...!"

While Daring Tact was getting changed, I 
considered several paths she could take 
for next year's Senior Class. Ultimately—
choice_data_list:
I think we should focus on the classic 
middle-distance route.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Does that mean... taking on races like 
today's? 
Aiming for premier medium-distance races?"
choice_data_list:
Yeah. That's where all the eyes are, after 
all.

Yeah. That's where all eyes are focused, 
after all.

text_block_list.text:
Naturally, we would continue competing in 
the Tiara route as well. 
However, she was far too grand to be 
confined to that alone—
choice_data_list: Let's go beyond the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...! 
Beyond it..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, I want to reach that place. 
Lead the way!"

That being said, Daring Tact had run hard 
all year, battling through the Triple 
Tiara and against senior runners. First, 
she needed some rest—
choice_data_list:
Let's kick things off with the Kinko Sho 
in March.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Back during the Junior Class, you 
always took great care with the spacing 
between my races, too."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Understood. Right now, I can believe in 
taking things steady without rushing."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you next 
year as well!

title: After the Japan Cup: Signal Fire of a New Era
